concerns.text: Task T035-SIM implements a 'deterministic simulation' using a fixed seed and normal distribution to generate scores, directly violating FR-015 which mandates '3 independent human raters' to score trajectories. This is a semantic weakening of the requirement: the task delivers a synthetic proxy instead of the required human evaluation mechanism, rendering the 'Human Evaluation Proxy' (FR-010) and Success Criterion SC-006 untestable as defined.

Task T035.1 generates a 'human-annotated subset' from existing data but fails to define the mechanism for actual human scoring required by FR-015. The task relies entirely on the simulation in T035-SIM, effectively dropping the 'human raters' acceptance criterion from the spec without explicit staging or amendment in the spec itself.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires results to be reproducible by re-running code against data. While T035-SIM is reproducible, it violates the project's core methodology defined in FR-015 (Human Evaluation). The task silently replaces a non-reproducible human step with a deterministic simulation without a constitutional amendment or explicit 'staged simplification' flag in the spec, constituting a silent drift from the project's defined research method.
